description: This is a header file defining interfaces, data structures, enums, and constants for resolving paths within a data model, likely used in an API for device or object management. It includes function declarations for resolving device paths, validating paths, and attaching error vectors, as well as enumerations to specify resolve operations and flags to control resolution behavior.

methods.name: PATH_RESOLVER_ResolveDevicePath
methods.description: Resolves a device path into component vectors based on the specified resolve operation and flags.

methods.name: PATH_RESOLVER_ResolvePath
methods.description: Resolves a general path into component vectors, with options for resolution depth and specific role and permission considerations.

methods.name: PATH_RESOLVER_ValidatePath
methods.description: Validates the syntax and correctness of a given path, possibly notifying about subscrition events.

methods.name: PATH_RESOLVER_AttachErrVector
methods.description: Attaches an error vector to a string vector for error reporting.
